source:
@@U02016@@
goes stark raving mad.
Why do you do it?
Why make common cause with us
when you can’ stand the heat?
You say you want to fly,
and yet your head goes all dizzy.
Did we make inroads on you,
or you on us?

@@U02018@@
Don't bare your teeth at me!
It disgusts me!
Great and glorious Spirit
who deigned to appear to me,
you who know my heart and soul,
why do you chain me
to this abominable creature
who feeds on misery
and gluts himself
on destruction?

@@U02020@@
Finished?

@@U02022@@
Save her,
or be damned and suffer for ages!

@@U02024@@
What’s that?
Loose the avenger’s chain's?
Undo his bolts?
I can’t!
Powerless!
“Save her!”
Who was it destroyed her?
You or I?
translation:
@@U02016@@
变得非常疯狂。
你为什么这么做？
为什么与我们共同事业
什么时候你能忍受高温？
你说你想飞
但你却感到头晕目眩。
我们侵入你了吗？
或者你对我们？

@@U02018@@
别对我露出牙齿！
真让我恶心！
伟大而荣耀的灵
谁屈尊出现在我面前，
你知道我的心和灵魂，
你为什么锁住我
对于这个可恶的生物
谁以痛苦为食
并让自己吃饱
关于毁灭？

@@U02020@@
完成了吗？

@@U02022@@
救救她，
不然就会被诅咒并受苦多年！

@@U02024@@
那是什么？
松开复仇者的锁链？
松开他的螺栓？
我不能！
无力！
“救救她！”
到底是谁毁了她？
你还是我？
